race.comment: One of the better midweek Benchmarks in recent memory. SHE'S AN ARTIST (4) has not lived up to the early boom and comes here looking for a confidence booster. Ran her best race for a while when a fast-finishing fifth, beaten under a length, in the Group 3 Nivison over this trip at Rosehill last start. Wins this if she brings her A-game. NAVY PILOT (1) copped early interference and didn't recover last time out in a BM94 over this distance at Randwick. Carries a similar weight after the claim and has improvement to come at the third run back. AMAZING EAGLE (9) contested the same race as NAVY PILOT at Randwick and was similarly disappointing. Overall record at 1200m is strong. Can bounce back under the light weight. MONTE KATE (8) drops 5kgs on her game effort at the Kenso recently. Five-time winner at 1200m - can never be ruled out. ASGARDA (5) finished just behind SHE'S AN ARTIST in the stakes race last time when resuming. Can improve sharply with the run under her belt.
